description: Four growth stages on 16x32: soil and a short stem, then leaves, then a wider leaf, then fruit. Each stage keeps the soil band so the bbox stays in range. Adjacent stages change only the plant, under the 35% frame-diff cap. Leaves use a yellow-green highlight and a blue-green shadow.
source_note: Kenney Roguelike sheet cell (2, 12) at 16px with a 1px gap
